_doc: Suppress specific QA issues. Each entry needs a reason. kind = issue kind from report.json (console-error, console-warning, pageerror, request-failed, http-status, unexpected-status, preloader-timeout, motion-tier, horizontal-overflow, stuck-end-state, rm-hidden-first-paint, focus-lost, skip-link-first, focus-not-visible, focus-order, script-error) or '*'. urlPattern / textPattern are JS regex sources tested against issue.url / issue.text. Suppressed issues are echoed in qa/report.md.

entries.textPattern: GL Driver Message .*GPU stall due to ReadPixels
entries.reason: Emitted by the GPU driver when this harness reads the framebuffer back to capture a screenshot of the live WebGL hero on '/', not by the site. Verified three ways that a real session produces no console output: qa/webgl.spec.ts (real Chrome, navigation + disposal), and two probes browsing '/' with pointer movement and scrolling both with and without screenshots. Appears only on '/' (the only WebGL route), only alongside screenshot capture, and is a driver performance note (it self-throttles with 'this message will no longer repeat') rather than a page error.
